item: row 361 group 4: the chronology timeline, session forensics, country form, keyword-growth chart and gold-set button follow a language switch
summary: Settings -> Advanced -> Diagnostics: the chronology timeline (row labels, hovers, legend) and its status line, the session-forensics report, the country-form reading and the keyword-growth chart wrote t() output into ordinary nodes and froze in the language they were drawn in. They now draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml (row 364) from the reading each was given. The chronology SVG is re-created by every draw, so its wheel, drag and double-click listeners moved to the host, bound once, reading the layout last drawn; a Chromium check confirmed zoom, pan and reset still work after a language repaint and that the repainted labels are in the new language. The keyword-growth chart shares the enlarge dialog with chartEnlarge, which leaves its title to the i18n walker, so the three nodes are released when the dialog closes. The gold-set button carries a translated title, so its labels are written as the English key for the walker (its Loading… label already was). Known and left: the chronology SUMMARY is drawn by _chronoRender from _chronoSummaryHtml (a sink with no t() beside a builder with no sink, so the scanner does not list it) and carries a live counter a redraw would fight; it is noted for row 365. Five lines leave configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt. No new strings.
